sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  participant Client
  participant API
  participant Auth
  participant Orders
  participant DB
  participant Queue
  Client->>API: POST /orders
  API->>Auth: verify token
  Auth-->>API: claims
  API->>Orders: create draft
  activate Orders
  Orders->>DB: BEGIN + INSERT
  DB-->>Orders: order id
  Orders->>Queue: enqueue confirmation
  Orders->>DB: COMMIT
  Orders-->>API: accepted
  deactivate Orders
  API-->>Client: 202 Accepted

sequenceDiagram
  participant Client
  participant Gateway
  participant API
  participant Idempotency
  participant DB
  Client->>Gateway: POST with idempotency key
  Gateway->>API: forward request
  API->>Idempotency: reserve key
  alt key is new
    Idempotency->>DB: insert processing key
    API->>DB: create payment
    DB-->>API: payment id
    API->>Idempotency: store response
    API-->>Client: 201 Created
  else key was completed
    Idempotency-->>API: cached response
    API-->>Client: 200 replayed response
  end

sequenceDiagram
  participant Worker
  participant DB
  participant Partner
  participant RetryQueue
  participant Alert
  Worker->>DB: lease pending webhook
  loop up to 3 attempts
    Worker->>Partner: POST event
    alt success
      Partner-->>Worker: 204
      Worker->>DB: mark delivered
    else transient failure
      Partner-->>Worker: 503
      Worker->>RetryQueue: schedule exponential backoff
    end
  end
  opt retry exhausted
    Worker->>DB: mark dead letter
    Worker->>Alert: notify on-call
  end

sequenceDiagram
  participant Author
  participant UI
  participant API
  participant Policy
  participant Approver
  participant Audit
  Author->>UI: submit change
  UI->>API: create approval request
  API->>Policy: evaluate risk
  alt approval required
    Policy-->>API: approver group
    API->>Approver: request decision
    Approver->>API: approve
    API->>Audit: append approved event
    API-->>UI: approved
  else auto approval
    API->>Audit: append auto-approved event
    API-->>UI: approved
  end

sequenceDiagram
  participant UI
  participant BFF
  participant Profile
  participant Billing
  participant Usage
  participant Flags
  UI->>BFF: load dashboard
  par profile
    BFF->>Profile: get profile
    Profile-->>BFF: profile
  and billing
    BFF->>Billing: get balance
    Billing-->>BFF: balance
  and usage
    BFF->>Usage: get metrics
    Usage-->>BFF: metrics
  and flags
    BFF->>Flags: resolve flags
    Flags-->>BFF: flags
  end
  BFF-->>UI: dashboard view model

sequenceDiagram
  participant Browser
  participant App
  participant Session
  participant OAuth
  participant TokenStore
  Browser->>App: request protected page
  App->>Session: read session
  alt access token expired
    Session->>OAuth: refresh token grant
    OAuth-->>Session: new access token
    Session->>TokenStore: rotate encrypted token
  else token active
    Session-->>App: access token
  end
  App-->>Browser: protected page

sequenceDiagram
  participant Checkout
  participant Inventory
  participant Payment
  participant Shipping
  participant Saga
  Checkout->>Inventory: reserve SKU
  Inventory-->>Checkout: reserved
  Checkout->>Payment: authorize card
  alt payment accepted
    Payment-->>Checkout: authorized
    Checkout->>Shipping: create shipment
    Shipping-->>Checkout: shipment id
    Checkout->>Saga: complete saga
  else payment declined
    Payment-->>Checkout: declined
    Checkout->>Inventory: release SKU
    Checkout->>Saga: compensate reservation
  end

sequenceDiagram
  participant JobA
  participant DB
  participant JobB
  participant Retry
  JobA->>DB: lock account A
  JobB->>DB: lock account B
  JobA->>DB: lock account B
  JobB->>DB: lock account A
  DB-->>JobB: deadlock detected
  JobB->>Retry: reschedule with jitter
  JobA->>DB: COMMIT
  Retry->>JobB: retry transaction
  JobB->>DB: lock accounts in canonical order
  DB-->>JobB: COMMIT

sequenceDiagram
  participant Client
  participant CDN
  participant Gateway
  participant Limiter
  participant API
  Client->>CDN: GET /report
  CDN->>Gateway: cache miss
  Gateway->>Limiter: consume tenant quota
  alt quota available
    Limiter-->>Gateway: allowed
    Gateway->>API: request report
    API-->>Client: 200 report
  else quota exhausted
    Limiter-->>Gateway: rejected
    Gateway-->>Client: 429 Retry-After
  end

sequenceDiagram
  participant Admin
  participant API
  participant DB
  participant Outbox
  participant Cache
  participant Reader
  Admin->>API: update catalog item
  API->>DB: BEGIN update item
  API->>Outbox: insert CatalogChanged
  API->>DB: COMMIT
  Outbox->>Cache: evict catalog key
  Reader->>Cache: get catalog
  Cache-->>Reader: miss
  Reader->>DB: reload catalog
  DB-->>Reader: fresh item

sequenceDiagram
  participant User
  participant API
  participant Storage
  participant Scanner
  participant DB
  User->>API: request upload URL
  API-->>User: signed URL
  User->>Storage: upload object
  Storage->>Scanner: object-created event
  activate Scanner
  Scanner->>Storage: read object
  Scanner->>DB: save scan result
  Scanner-->>API: file ready
  deactivate Scanner
  API-->>User: upload complete

sequenceDiagram
  participant Client
  participant DNS
  participant RegionA
  participant Health
  participant RegionB
  Client->>DNS: resolve api.example
  DNS-->>Client: RegionA
  Client->>RegionA: request
  RegionA-->>Client: timeout
  Client->>Health: report failed endpoint
  Health->>DNS: withdraw RegionA
  Client->>DNS: resolve again
  DNS-->>Client: RegionB
  Client->>RegionB: retry request
  RegionB-->>Client: 200

sequenceDiagram
  participant Broker
  participant Consumer
  participant Dedup
  participant DB
  participant Projection
  Broker->>Consumer: delivery event E42
  Consumer->>Dedup: claim event id
  alt first delivery
    Dedup->>DB: insert processed event
    Consumer->>Projection: apply update
    Projection->>DB: commit projection
    Consumer-->>Broker: ack
  else duplicate delivery
    Dedup-->>Consumer: already processed
    Consumer-->>Broker: ack without apply
  end

sequenceDiagram
  participant Requester
  participant Portal
  participant API
  participant RiskEngine
  participant Compliance
  participant Director
  Requester->>Portal: request production export for tenant 한국어-고객
  Portal->>API: create export request with immutable audit context
  API->>RiskEngine: calculate data sensitivity and business impact
  RiskEngine->>Compliance: require legal basis validation
  Compliance->>Director: seek delegated approval
  Director-->>Compliance: approve with expiry
  Compliance-->>API: policy satisfied
  API-->>Portal: export is authorized

sequenceDiagram
  participant Scheduler
  participant Worker
  participant Vendor
  participant DB
  participant Metrics
  loop every 5 minutes
    Scheduler->>Worker: poll account
    Worker->>Vendor: fetch cursor page
    Vendor-->>Worker: page and next cursor
    Worker->>DB: upsert records
    Worker->>Metrics: record lag
  end

sequenceDiagram
  participant Client
  participant API
  participant Flags
  participant Legacy
  participant NewPath
  Client->>API: evaluate checkout
  API->>Flags: lookup checkout-v2
  alt flag enabled
    Flags-->>API: true
    API->>NewPath: execute new checkout
    NewPath-->>Client: v2 response
  else flag disabled
    Flags-->>API: false
    API->>Legacy: execute legacy checkout
    Legacy-->>Client: legacy response
  end

sequenceDiagram
  participant Client
  participant API
  participant Service
  participant DB
  Client->>API: PATCH profile
  API->>Service: validate and persist
  alt valid request
    opt email changed
      Service->>DB: reserve email
      DB-->>Service: reserved
    end
    Service->>DB: update profile
    DB-->>Service: committed
    Service-->>API: success
  else invalid request
    Service-->>API: validation errors
  end
  API-->>Client: response

sequenceDiagram
  participant Browser
  participant Merchant
  participant PSP
  participant Issuer
  participant Webhook
  Browser->>Merchant: pay invoice
  Merchant->>PSP: authorize
  PSP->>Issuer: 3DS challenge
  Issuer-->>Browser: challenge page
  Browser->>Issuer: challenge result
  Issuer-->>PSP: authenticated
  PSP-->>Merchant: pending
  PSP->>Webhook: payment succeeded event
  Webhook->>Merchant: settle invoice

sequenceDiagram
  participant Request
  participant API
  participant Tracer
  participant Worker
  participant Collector
  participant UI
  Request->>API: POST /imports
  API->>Tracer: start trace
  API->>Worker: enqueue import with traceparent
  Worker->>Tracer: continue trace
  Worker->>Collector: send spans
  Collector-->>UI: trace timeline
  API-->>Request: 202 trace id

sequenceDiagram
  participant User
  participant API
  participant Auth
  participant RLS
  participant DB
  User->>API: GET /customers
  API->>Auth: authenticate tenant T-42
  Auth-->>API: tenant claim
  API->>RLS: set tenant context
  RLS->>DB: query under tenant policy
  DB-->>API: only T-42 rows
  API-->>User: customers

sequenceDiagram
  participant User
  participant UI
  participant API
  participant Exporter
  participant Storage
  participant Email
  User->>UI: start export
  UI->>API: POST /exports
  API->>Exporter: enqueue query
  API-->>UI: 202 job id
  Exporter->>Storage: write CSV chunks
  Exporter->>Email: send completion mail
  Email-->>User: download link

sequenceDiagram
  participant API
  participant Breaker
  participant Vendor
  participant Fallback
  API->>Breaker: call enrichment
  alt breaker closed
    Breaker->>Vendor: request enrichment
    Vendor-->>Breaker: timeout
    Breaker->>Breaker: record failure
  else breaker open
    Breaker->>Fallback: return cached classification
    Fallback-->>API: degraded answer
  end

sequenceDiagram
  participant Worker
  participant LeaseDB
  participant Queue
  participant Job
  Worker->>LeaseDB: acquire lease
  LeaseDB-->>Worker: lease token
  Worker->>Queue: receive job
  loop while processing
    Worker->>LeaseDB: renew lease token
    LeaseDB-->>Worker: renewed
  end
  Worker->>Job: execute
  Job-->>Worker: complete
  Worker->>LeaseDB: release lease

sequenceDiagram
  participant User
  participant ChatAPI
  participant Moderation
  participant Store
  participant Fanout
  participant Recipient
  User->>ChatAPI: send message
  ChatAPI->>Moderation: classify content
  alt allowed
    Moderation-->>ChatAPI: allow
    ChatAPI->>Store: persist message
    ChatAPI->>Fanout: publish message
    Fanout-->>Recipient: deliver
  else blocked
    Moderation-->>ChatAPI: block
    ChatAPI-->>User: policy error
  end

sequenceDiagram
  participant Scheduler
  participant Reconciler
  participant Ledger
  participant PSP
  participant DB
  Scheduler->>Reconciler: nightly run
  par local totals
    Reconciler->>Ledger: aggregate settled amounts
    Ledger-->>Reconciler: local total
  and provider totals
    Reconciler->>PSP: fetch settlement report
    PSP-->>Reconciler: provider total
  end
  Reconciler->>DB: record variance
  opt variance found
    Reconciler->>DB: create investigation
  end

sequenceDiagram
  participant Writer
  participant API
  participant OldDB
  participant NewDB
  participant Verifier
  Writer->>API: update customer
  API->>OldDB: write legacy record
  API->>NewDB: write new record
  API->>Verifier: compare checksums
  alt checksums match
    Verifier-->>API: consistent
    API-->>Writer: success
  else mismatch
    Verifier-->>API: divergence
    API-->>Writer: accepted with repair queued
  end

sequenceDiagram
  participant Operator
  participant API
  participant Batch
  participant DB
  participant Audit
  Operator->>API: start bulk update
  API->>Batch: validate records
  Batch->>DB: BEGIN
  loop each record
    Batch->>DB: apply update
  end
  alt all records valid
    Batch->>DB: COMMIT
    Batch->>Audit: record batch complete
  else validation fails
    Batch->>DB: ROLLBACK
    Batch->>Audit: record rejected batch
  end

sequenceDiagram
  participant Recipient
  participant UnsubscribeURL
  participant API
  participant Consent
  participant ESP
  Recipient->>UnsubscribeURL: click unsubscribe
  UnsubscribeURL->>API: signed unsubscribe request
  API->>Consent: revoke marketing consent
  Consent->>ESP: suppress address
  ESP-->>API: suppression confirmed
  API-->>Recipient: unsubscribed

sequenceDiagram
  participant Mobile
  participant Edge
  participant Gateway
  participant API
  participant Domain
  participant DB
  Mobile->>Edge: request with device context and signed nonce
  Edge->>Gateway: forward after WAF inspection
  Gateway->>API: forward after rate quota decision
  API->>Domain: construct command with tenant context
  Domain->>DB: validate optimistic version and persist event
  DB-->>Domain: committed version 18
  Domain-->>API: aggregate result
  API-->>Gateway: serialized response
  Gateway-->>Edge: response headers
  Edge-->>Mobile: 200 payload

sequenceDiagram
  participant Client
  participant API
  participant DB
  Client->>API: PUT document version 7
  API->>DB: update where version equals 7
  alt version matches
    DB-->>API: version 8
    API-->>Client: 200
  else version conflict
    DB-->>API: zero rows updated
    API-->>Client: 409 latest version
    Client->>API: GET latest document
  end

sequenceDiagram
  participant Admin
  participant API
  participant Sessions
  participant Cache
  participant Audit
  Admin->>API: revoke user sessions
  API->>Sessions: invalidate refresh tokens
  Sessions->>Cache: evict session keys
  Sessions->>Audit: append revocation event
  API-->>Admin: revoked

sequenceDiagram
  participant Producer
  participant Broker
  participant Consumer
  participant Autoscaler
  participant Metrics
  Producer->>Broker: publish events
  Consumer->>Broker: receive batch
  Consumer->>Metrics: report processing lag
  alt lag above threshold
    Metrics->>Autoscaler: scale consumers
    Autoscaler-->>Consumer: new replicas
  else lag stable
    Metrics-->>Autoscaler: hold capacity
  end

sequenceDiagram
  participant Subject
  participant Portal
  participant PrivacyAPI
  participant Identity
  participant Erasure
  participant Audit
  Subject->>Portal: request deletion
  Portal->>PrivacyAPI: submit verified request
  PrivacyAPI->>Identity: confirm account ownership
  Identity-->>PrivacyAPI: verified
  PrivacyAPI->>Erasure: execute retention policy
  Erasure->>Audit: record legal basis and result
  PrivacyAPI-->>Portal: deletion scheduled

sequenceDiagram
  participant UI
  participant Gateway
  participant Loader
  participant DB
  UI->>Gateway: GraphQL dashboard query
  Gateway->>Loader: collect customer ids
  Loader->>DB: batch select customers
  DB-->>Loader: rows
  Loader-->>Gateway: hydrated fields
  Gateway-->>UI: one response

sequenceDiagram
  participant Deployer
  participant Control
  participant Green
  participant Probe
  participant Router
  Deployer->>Control: deploy green version
  Control->>Green: start instances
  Green->>Probe: report readiness
  Probe-->>Control: healthy
  Control->>Router: shift 10 percent traffic
  opt metrics healthy
    Control->>Router: shift 100 percent traffic
  end

sequenceDiagram
  participant Model
  participant Orchestrator
  participant Reviewer
  participant Tool
  participant Audit
  Model->>Orchestrator: propose database action
  Orchestrator->>Reviewer: request human approval
  alt approved
    Reviewer-->>Orchestrator: approve
    Orchestrator->>Tool: execute scoped action
    Tool-->>Orchestrator: result
    Orchestrator->>Audit: record approval and result
  else rejected
    Reviewer-->>Orchestrator: reject
    Orchestrator->>Audit: record rejection
  end

sequenceDiagram
  participant Client
  participant API
  participant Search
  participant Recommend
  participant Cache
  Client->>API: load discovery page
  par search
    API->>Search: query index
    Search-->>API: results
  and recommendations
    API->>Recommend: fetch suggestions
    Recommend-->>API: timeout
  end
  API->>Cache: fallback recommendations
  Cache-->>API: cached suggestions
  API-->>Client: page with degraded recommendations

sequenceDiagram
  participant CronA
  participant Lock
  participant CronB
  participant Job
  CronA->>Lock: try acquire daily lock
  CronB->>Lock: try acquire daily lock
  alt CronA owns lock
    Lock-->>CronA: acquired
    CronA->>Job: run billing close
    CronA->>Lock: release
  else CronB loses lock
    Lock-->>CronB: already held
    CronB->>CronB: skip run
  end

sequenceDiagram
  participant Producer
  participant Registry
  participant Broker
  participant Consumer
  Producer->>Registry: validate event schema v3
  Registry-->>Producer: compatible
  Producer->>Broker: publish event v3
  Consumer->>Registry: resolve reader schema
  Registry-->>Consumer: migration rules
  Consumer->>Consumer: deserialize event

sequenceDiagram
  participant Monitor
  participant Alertmanager
  participant OnCall
  participant Runbook
  participant StatusPage
  Monitor->>Alertmanager: SLO breach
  Alertmanager->>OnCall: page primary
  OnCall->>Runbook: execute diagnosis
  opt customer impact confirmed
    OnCall->>StatusPage: publish incident
  end
  loop every 30 minutes
    OnCall->>StatusPage: update status
  end

  Granted --> [*]

  SecurityReview --> Denied: security fail

  [*] --> Cart

  Addressed --> Paying

  Paying --> Cart: payment failed

  Fulfilled --> [*]

  Deleting --> Held: legal hold
  Held --> Deleting: hold released
  Deleted --> [*]

  Closed --> Open: failures threshold
  Open --> HalfOpen: cooldown elapsed

  HalfOpen --> Open: probe fails

stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Available

  Reserved --> Available: reservation expires

  Returned --> Available: restocked
  Available --> [*]

  Failed --> Dirty: repair mapping

  [*] --> Ready
  Ready --> Complete

  Appealed --> Won: appeal accepts

  Lost --> [*]
